rule: Compare mean bb/100 across the four finals. Prefer simpler v6 if the difference is within twice the conservative sum of the candidates mean-SE bounds (each mean bound is average marginal SE); otherwise use the higher mean. A clear loss to its parent is a warning requiring disclosure. RandomBot is only a sanity check.
excluded_v8: 256 samples showed no development improvement over v6 and doubles candidate Monte Carlo cost.
